description: "When Were Our Gospels Written?" by Charles Bradlaugh is a critical examination of the authenticity and credibility of the four Gospels, written in the late 19th century. This scientific publication aims to explore the timeframe in which the Gospels were composed while addressing the implications for Christianity, particularly the validity of its core narratives.
